authoring.method: Read the declared preimplementation interface and existing producer specification; author finite expected distinctions and protocol boundary cases. No new meaning-preservation runtime implementation or result was used.
authoring.independence_boundary: Same project team and exposed after freeze; not a blind human linguistic study. Existing productive examples repeat installed scope and are integration controls, not new grammar accuracy evidence.

ordering_contract: Parse all inputs before semantic checks; check payload fibers before per-case binding, context and observation; return the first witness. A null expected reason means no particular diagnostic string is imposed.
authority_contract: Every public result keeps all five authority flags false. Native results separately keep world_truth_established and whole_arabic_completeness_established false. Complete refers only to the declared finite transport contract and does not authenticate original inputs.

fixture_contract.object_request: Send exact request object through the public wrapper and, where meaningful, native checker.
fixture_contract.raw_json: Send the exact UTF-8 text before any JSON parser can erase duplicate keys.
fixture_contract.raw_bytes_hex: Decode literal hexadecimal bytes and send them to the input boundary.
fixture_contract.expanded_source_text: Replace the original source_text and decoded payload source_text by the exact ASCII repetition, then serialize the payload with no other modification.
fixture_contract.padded_json_with_trailing_spaces: Serialize request to UTF-8 then append only ASCII spaces until exact total_bytes is reached.
fixture_contract.native_control: Run in an isolated test fixture with missing native binary or a process exiting nonzero. Never mint a synthetic successful native receipt.
fixture_contract.productive_request: Invoke the installed producer through the new adapter with exact original request. For transport_edit, first obtain a fresh complete public original Packet, deep-copy it, swap every reading subject/object, serialize it, then invoke the adapter again with that actual payload. If producer does not complete, the positive goal is a miss, not a successful abstention.
